name_de: Cube Supreme RT Hybrid Comfort EX 600
name_en: Cube Supreme RT Hybrid Comfort EX 600
description_de: Das Cube Supreme RT Hybrid Comfort EX 600 ist ein E-Citybike von Cube. Der Antrieb (Bosch Performance Line) mit bis zu 75 Nm Drehmoment wird von einem 600-Wh-Akku gespeist. Schaltung: Shimano Nexus SL-C7000-5, Revoshift. Bremsen: Shimano Alfine BR-S7000, Disc. Brake (160/180). Rahmen: Aluminium Superlite. Erhältlich in den Größen 42 cm, 46 cm, 50 cm, 54 cm, 58 cm.
description_en: The Cube Supreme RT Hybrid Comfort EX 600 is an electric city bike from Cube. The drive (Bosch Performance Line) with up to 75 Nm of torque is powered by a 600 Wh battery. Drivetrain: Shimano Nexus SL-C7000-5, Revoshift. Brakes: Shimano Alfine BR-S7000, Disc. Brake (160/180). Frame: Aluminium Superlite. Available in sizes 42 cm, 46 cm, 50 cm, 54 cm, 58 cm.

features_en: Bosch Performance Line, up to 75 Nm, 600 Wh battery
